give up: Never give up your dream, even when things get really hard.
即使事情变得非常艰难，也永远不要放弃你的梦想。
clean up: Please clean up your room before your friends arrive this afternoon.
请在今天下午朋友们到来之前把你的房间打扫干净。
cheer up: She bought him a small gift to cheer him up after the exam.
考试结束后，她给他买了一份小礼物让他振作起来。
give out: The sun gives out light and heat every day without stopping.
太阳每天都不停地发出光和热。
come up with: He came up with a clever idea to solve the difficult math problem.
他想出了一个巧妙的办法来解决这道很难的数学题。
put off: Don't put off today's work until tomorrow, or it will pile up.
不要把今天的工作推迟到明天，否则它会越积越多。
hand out: The teacher asked me to hand out the test papers to the class.
老师让我把试卷分发给我全班同学。
call up: I will call you up as soon as I arrive at the train station.
我一到火车站就给你打电话。
used to: My grandfather used to tell me stories about his childhood in the countryside.
我爷爷过去常常给我讲他童年时在乡下的故事。
care for: Nurses care for the sick people in the hospital day and night.
护士们日夜照料着医院里的病人。
try out: I want to try out the new computer before deciding whether to buy it.
我想先试用一下这台新电脑，再决定是否购买。
fix up: My father helped me fix up the old bike so that I could ride to school.
爸爸帮我把旧自行车修好了，这样我就能骑车上学了。
give away: The kind man decided to give away all his old books to the village school.
那位善良的男子决定把他所有的旧书赠送给乡村学校。
take after: Everyone says the daughter takes after her mother in both looks and character.
大家都说这女儿在外貌和性格上都像她妈妈。
set up: The students set up a small library in their classroom last month.
上个月学生们在教室里建立了一个小图书角。
make a difference: Even a small act of kindness can make a difference to someone's life.
哪怕一个小小的善举也能改变一个人的生活。
take out the rubbish: Remember to take out the rubbish before you leave for school.
上学出发前记得把垃圾拿出去倒了。
all the time: My little brother watches cartoons all the time on weekends.
我弟弟周末一直在看动画片。
as soon as: As soon as the bell rang, the students rushed out of the classroom.
铃声一响，学生们就冲出了教室。
in order to: She gets up early every morning in order to catch the first bus.
为了赶上首班公交车，她每天早上都起得很早。
depend on: Whether we go hiking depends on the weather this weekend.
我们是否去徒步取决于这个周末的天气。
take care of: You should take care of yourself when your parents are away on business.
父母出差不在家时，你应该照顾好自己。
What's wrong?: You look pale today. What's wrong with you?
你今天看起来脸色苍白，你怎么了？
look through: I looked through the newspaper quickly while having breakfast.
我一边吃早餐一边快速浏览了报纸。
big deal: It's not a big deal if you lose one game; just try again next time.
输掉一场比赛没什么大不了的，下次再努力就好。
work out: They talked for hours and finally worked out a plan together.
他们谈了几个小时，最后一起制定出了一个计划。
get on well (with): He gets on well with his classmates and often helps them with their lessons.
他和同学们相处融洽，经常在学习上帮助他们。
cut out: The doctor advised him to cut out coffee before going to bed.
医生建议他睡前不要喝咖啡。
compare…with: Don't compare yourself with others; just try to be better than yesterday.
不要拿自己和别人比较，只要努力比昨天的自己更好就行。
in one's opinion: In my opinion, reading more books is the best way to learn a language.
依我看，多读书是学习一门语言最好的方法。
go off: The fire alarm went off suddenly in the middle of the night.
半夜里火警警报器突然响了起来。
pick up: Please pick up the books on the floor and put them on the shelf.
请把地板上的书捡起来放到书架上。
fall asleep: He was so tired that he fell asleep as soon as he lay down.
他太累了，一躺下就睡着了。
die down: The strong wind began to die down after the storm passed.
暴风雨过后，大风开始逐渐减弱了。
make one's way: After the concert ended, the crowd made its way slowly to the exits.
音乐会结束后，人群缓慢地向外出口移动。
in silence: The two friends walked home in silence after the argument.
争吵之后，两个朋友默默地走路回家。
take down: The secretary took down everything important during the meeting.
秘书在会议期间把所有重要的内容都记录了下来。
at first: At first I didn't like the new school, but now I love it.
起初我不喜欢新学校，但现在我爱上它了。
a little bit: This soup is a little bit salty, but it still tastes good.
这汤有点咸，不过味道还是不错的。
instead of: You should drink water instead of soda when you are thirsty.
口渴的时候你应该喝水，而不是喝汽水。
